page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Margin notes in the right margin, beside their lines. Running head at the top centre. Page number at the top right. Gathering signature at the foot centre.

main_text.p: quam Darius regnare coeperat, idq; Iudeis latis visum: & quia magnæ molis erat urbem restituere, diffili viribus, opus multi laboris incipere nō ausi, templo continebantur. Per idem tempus Esdras scriba legis post viginti fere annos quam templum fuerat consummatum, defuncto jam Dario, qui unum de viginti annis rerum fuerat potitus, permissu Artaxerxis{*} secundi,{a} non illius qui inter duos Xerxes fuit: sed hujus qui Dario Ocho successerat, Baby[?] Ionia profectus: multiq; eum sequuti Hierosolymā pervenere.a Mem.Esd. 7. Vasa quoq; diversi operis, & dona, quæ rex templo Dei miserat, cum duodecim Levitis. Vix enim hic numerus ex illa tribu repertus traditur. Is cum deprehendisset Iudæos gentili-um connubiis permissos, multis increpitos, renunciare istiusmodi matrimoniis, ac filios ex his susceptos extrudi jubet o-mnesq; dicto paruere. Purgatus populus, veteris legis ritum habebat.Lex resti- tuta Iu- deis.Esd. 8.Esd. 9. & 10.1. Esd. 9. Ceterum El-dram nihil super reficienda urbe egisse comperio.2. Esd. 1. credo potiorem curam ratus, plebem corruptis moribus reformare. erat ea tempestate apud Babyloniam Ne.[?]emias{b}, minister regius, gente Iudæus, Ar-b Pincerna.Nehem. 1.

page.notes: Page number "105" read from a worn top-right numeral; the running head is read clearly. Uncertain readings: "Baby[?]" (line break shows "Baby" followed by "Ionia", so the word is probably Babylonia). "Ne.[?]emias" (the name is broken at the line end; the first part reads "Ne." and the rest "emias"). Marginal "Lex resti- tuta Iu- deis." is read from three short margin lines and may be partly misread. Marginal "a Mem." and "b Pincerna." are faint; the asterisk after Artaxerxis is a reference mark. Long s is normalised to plain s in the text. Printed spelling kept as read, including "Vasa", "Hierosolymā" and "Ocho". No catchword.
